Konstrukcje od 36 000 zł netto, całe boi: Structures start at PLN 36,000 excluding VAT; a complete court with slab and painting, e.g. Panna Play, starts at PLN 51,000 excluding VAT. I calculate installation, transport and site preparation after reviewing site photos.
Czy da się zrobić boisko na starym beton: Can a court be built on existing concrete?
Zwykle tak. Jeśli beton jest stabilny, n: Usually, yes. If the concrete is stable, I repair cracks and defects, prime the substrate and apply flexible sports paint with rubber granules, followed by patterns and markings. If the substrate is severely damaged, it must first be rebuilt.
Ile miejsca potrzebuję?: How much space do I need?
To zależy od konstrukcji i strefy bezpie: It depends on the structure and safety zones. The smallest arenas are around 5 m in diameter; a 3v3 court measures 15 × 10 m. Enter the site dimensions in the “Will it fit?” planner.
Rok gwarancji i stała opieka nad renowac: One year of warranty and ongoing renovation support after handover. I include manufacturers' technical sheets and certificates in the quotation and documentation.
